basic_info.description: This quintessential San Francisco co-op is the perfect blend of classic 1920s architecture & the modern style & conveniences of the 21st century. Impeccably remodeled in 2022, this chic & sophisticated home features parquet flooring throughout, coved ceilings, modern light fixtures and other rich decorative details. It features a wonderful open concept living/dining/kitchen & 2 ensuite bedrooms. Boasting windows on the south, west & east sides, the home is filled w/ natural light w/picturesque views. Gourmet kitchen includes Vadara Quartz countertops & Miele & Thermador appliances. Generous living room includes ornate woodburning fireplace w/ period details. There is a dedicated space for a home office or homework area. In-unit laundry & separate private storage. 1 dog or cat up to 25 lbs permitted. 1-car garage accessible by 2 elevators is large enough for an SUV.  Building features elegant lobby, elaborate millwork, tile & stained  glass. Monthly dues incl 24-hour on-site resident manager. One block from Union St's upscale shopping & dining. Perfect 100 WalkScore w/proximity to the Marina, Presidio, Fillmore & Chestnut Sts. Beautifully staged by Vesta, and all furniture available for purchase with the property. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own in this desirable building!
